CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 27, 2020 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR RED RIBBON WEEK - It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 23 through October 30, 2020 as Red Ribbon Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Safety Education Officer Mary Cipres.
6.1 Proclamation for Red Ribbon Week
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of October 13, 2020 and the City Council meeting of October 13, 2020.
7.1 Minutes of October 13, 2020 Study Session
7.1 Minutes of October 13, 2020 Council Meeting
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 27, 2020 in the total amount of $2,428,182.34.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
THEATRE CONCESSION AGREEMENT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for the Theatre’s concessionaire services to Sunseri’s and authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement on behalf of the City.
7.3 Theatre Concession Agreement
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-04, TELEGRAPH ROAD AT WICKER DRIVE/HUTCHINS DRIVE TRAFFIC SIGNAL – APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT TO ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL/TECHNICAL SERVICES AGREEMENT TO MICHAEL BAKER INTERNATIONAL INC. FOR PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING DESIGN SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council accept the proposal from Michael Baker International, Inc. for professional engineering design services in the amount of $40,750; authorize the City Manager to approve an addendum to the existing On-Call Professional/Technical Services Agreement for professional engineering design services to Michael Baker International, Inc. in the amount of $40,750; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services, if required, to Michael Baker International, Inc. for up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount.
7.4 CIP No. 2020-04
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-02, ALONDRA BOULEVARD PAVEMENT REHABILITATION FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO MOTTLEY DRIVE - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-02, Alondra Boulevard Pavement Rehabilitation from Valley View Avenue to Mottley Drive, to R.J. Noble Company in the amount of $1,508,409.30; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total construction cost.
7.5 CIP No. 2018-02
7.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-08, PHASE 6A, RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for CIP No. 2018-08, Phase 6A, Residential Street Rehabilitation; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.6 CIP No. 2018-08
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-29 APPROVING A RESOLUTION OF NECESSITY FOR THE ACQUISITION BY EMINENT DOMAIN OF CERTAIN REAL PROPERTY INTERESTS FOR PUBLIC PURPOSES FOR THE VALLEY VIEW AVENUE AND ALONDRA BOULEVARD INTERSECTION IMPROVEMENT PROJECT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing on the adoption of the proposed Resolution of Necessity, receive from staff the evidence stated and referred to in this Agenda Report ("Report"), take testimony from any person wishing to be heard and consider all evidence to determine whether to adopt proposed Resolution of Necessity, which requires the City Council's separate consideration and determination; find that the public interest, convenience and necessity require the acquisition of the proposed Subject Property for the benefit of the City's intersection and roadway widening Project; find that Project is located in the manner that will be most compatible with the greatest public good and the least private injury; find that the Subject Property sought to be acquired is necessary for the City's intersection and roadway widening Project; find that without the acquisition of the Subject Property, the City will not be able to proceed with the Project; find that the offer required by Section 7267.2 of the Government Code has been made to the owners of record of the property to be acquired; adopt Resolution No. 20-29 approving a Resolution of Necessity declaring certain real property interests located at 15910 Valley View Avenue, and further identified as Assessor's Parcel Number 7001-013-126 ("Subject Property"), necessary for public purposes and authorizing the acquisition thereof, in connection with the Valley View Avenue and Alondra Boulevard Intersection Improvement Project ("Project"); authorize the City's Attorney and City staff to take all necessary steps to deposit with the Court the amount of probable compensation required by law for issuance of the Order for Possession; and authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute all necessary documents.
8.1 Public Hearing - Resolution No. 20-29
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-30 APPROVING THE VACATING AND ABANDONING OF A CERTAIN UTILITY EASEMENT MORE SPECIFICALLY LOCATED AT 15300 DESMAN ROAD - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-30 approving the vacating and abandoning of said utility easement located at 15300 Desman Road, and authorize the City Clerk to submit the document for recordation in the office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
9.1 Resolution No. 20-30
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 20-31 APPROVING THE GRANT AND CONVEYANCE OF AN EASEMENT TO SUBURBAN WATER SYSTEMS FOR WATER PIPES AND APPURTENANCES LOCATED WITHIN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA CIVIC CENTER PARKING LOT - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-31 granting and conveying an easement to Suburban Water Systems for water pipes and appurtenances located within the City of La Mirada Civic Center parking lot, as further described in Exhibit A and delineated in Exhibit B; authorize the Mayor to sign the Grant of Easement on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to sign such further documents and take such further actions to affect the transactions described herein; and authorize the City Clerk to submit the documents for recordation in the office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
9.2 Resolution No. 20-31
9.3
RESOLUTION NO. 20-32 APPROVING A SUBEASEMENT AGREEMENT WITH SUBURBAN WATER SYSTEMS FOR THE MAINTENANCE, REPAIR AND REPLACEMENT OF WATER PIPES AND APPUTENANCES WITHIN CIVIC CENTER DRIVE - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-32 approving the Subeasement Agreement with Suburban Water Systems for the maintenance, repair and replacement of water pipes and appurtenances within the City of La Mirada utility easement located within Civic Center Drive; authorize the City Manager to execute the Subeasement Agreement on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to sign such further documents and take such further actions to affect the transactions described herein; and authorize the City Clerk to submit the documents for recordation in the office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
9.3 Resolution No. 20-32
